perimeterlens today is a one-shot, run-it-yourself CLI. It does not currently
offer scheduled re-scans, diffing, or alerting.

If you'd want that, opening this issue is how we gauge real interest before
building it — nothing is provisioned automatically when you open this, and
no charge exists yet or is implied.
